$$\begin{array}{l}
x(x+2)+(x+2)(x+4)+\ldots .+(x+2 n-2)(x+2 n) \\

(1) 3

$$\begin{array}{l}
\Rightarrow \sum_{r=1}^{n}(x+2 r-2)(x+2 r)=\frac{8 n}{3} \\
